Professional Gas Range: Features four burners, a stainless steel backsplash, and a modern oven.

Essential Appliances: Includes a microwave, toaster, kettle, and an under-counter fridge/freezer.

Bedroom 1: Features a comfortable double bed with fresh linens.

Bedroom 2: Includes another double bed, ideal for couples or friends.

Fresh, fluffy towels and free toiletries.

The Master Suite
Retire to a quiet, spacious bedroom designed for deep rest:

Spa-Inspired Bathroom
Refresh in our pristine, modern bathroom equipped with:

• Walk-In Rainfall Shower: A glass-enclosed space with modern gray tiling.
• Essentials: We provide complimentary toiletries and fluffy, hotel-quality towels for every stay.

Location & Convenience
You couldn't be better placed to explore the area:

• Steps Away: Local boutiques, cafes, and historic landmarks like Dunfermline Abbey and Pittencrieff Park are right at your doorstep.
• Commuter Friendly: Easy access to Edinburgh (just 20km from the airport) and the iconic Forth Bridge.
• Stress-Free Parking: Skip the city center fees, enjoy free on-site private parking included with your stay.

Guest will have access to the whole apartment unit.

We offer a completely independent self-check-in process to give you maximum flexibility and privacy. You will retrieve your keys from a secure lockbox at the building entrance. While we won't be there to meet you in person, we are available 24/7 via the messaging app or phone should you have any questions about the apartment or need local recommendations.

Historic Dunfermline
The Heart of Fife: Nestled in the center of Scotland’s newest city, the street offers a perfect blend of historic charm and modern convenience.

Historic Heritage Quarter: You are just steps away from Dunfermline’s rich history, including the magnificent Dunfermline Abbey, the burial place of Robert the Bruce, and the 16th-century Abbot House.

Green Spaces: A short walk brings you to the award-winning Pittencrieff Park (known locally as "The Glen"), featuring 76 acres of landscaped gardens, woodland walks, and resident peacocks.

Shopping & Dining: The neighborhood is a hub for local culture, with a variety of independent cafés, traditional Scottish pubs, and the Kingsgate Shopping Centre all within walking distance.

Cultural Landmarks: Explore the life of the town's most famous son at the Andrew Carnegie Birthplace Museum or catch a show at the historic Carnegie Hall.

Getting Around
Walkability: The central location means most city attractions, supermarkets, and essential services are easily accessible on foot.

Public Transport: The Dunfermline Bus Station is approximately a 5–10 minute walk away, and the Dunfermline City Rail Station is nearby, providing regular 30-minute connections to the heart of Edinburgh.

Regional Base: This is an ideal location for exploring the Fife Coastal Path, nearby historic castles like Culross, or taking a scenic drive to St Andrews.

Dunfermline Bus Station: Situated directly, the main city bus hub is only a 5-minute walk from your door. It provides frequent regional services to Edinburgh (approx. 1 hour), Glasgow, St Andrews, and Perth.

Dunfermline City Train Station: Located just half a mile away (approx. 10–12 minute walk), this station offers direct, frequent rail connections to Edinburgh Waverley in just 32–35 minutes via the scenic Fife Circle Line.

Airport Access: The Stagecoach JET 747 bus departs regularly from the nearby Halbeath Park & Ride and Inverkeithing Rail Station, providing a direct link to Edinburgh Airport.

Local Travel
Walkability: Most major attractions, including Dunfermline Abbey, Pittencrieff Park, and the Kingsgate Shopping Centre, are reachable within a 5–10 minute walk.

Taxis: A dedicated taxi rank is located, just 30 meters from the bus station entrance.

Cycling: Secure cycle lockers are available at the bus station for those exploring the area on two wheels.
